tasks.description: Create isolated and repeatable C++ test fixtures for database-backed model verification.

steps.description: Create a dedicated test schema template for C++ test runs.
Add fixture utilities that reset tables before each case.
Wire fixture bootstrap into cluster_chat_unit build target.
Document deterministic setup inputs in test README.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: C++ test runs must initialize an isolated schema before each suite. Fixture reset must leave zero residual rows across repeated runs. cluster_chat_unit must execute fixture bootstrap without manual pre-steps.

unit: Given fixture reset input with pre-seeded rows, reset utility must return table counts as zero for all managed tables.
Given two sequential fixture initializations with the same seed set, generated primary keys must match expected deterministic values.
Given missing fixture config input, bootstrap loader must return explicit failure code with non-empty error message.

tasks.description: Implement isolated unit tests for UserModel, FriendModel, and GroupModel behaviors using fixture-seeded stub data.

steps.description: Add UserModel tests for insert, query, state update, password update.
Add UserModel tests for queryByName plus resetState branches.
Add FriendModel tests for insert, query, isFriend behavior.
Add GroupModel tests for create, membership, role query, role update, removal.
Add edge case tests for duplicate rows, missing ids, invalid ids.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: UserModel tests must cover insert, query, queryByName, updateState, updatePassword, resetState. FriendModel tests must cover insert, isFriend, query. GroupModel tests must cover CreateGroup, AddGroup, QueryGroupUsers, QueryUserRole, UpdateUserRole, RemoveGroupUser. All model tests must pass in two consecutive runs with identical results.

unit: Given fixture-seeded user row id=101, UserModel.query(101) must return matching name plus expected state value.
Given existing username 'alice', UserModel.queryByName('alice') must return id=101 from stub seed set.
Given FriendModel seed pair (101,102), isFriend(101,102) must return true and isFriend(101,999) must return false.
Given GroupModel seed with role='creator', QueryUserRole(groupId,userId) must return 'creator' for seeded member.
Given duplicate AddGroup input for same user plus group, method must reject insertion with deterministic failure result.
integration: When connected to real layer 'Establish Deterministic Cpp Test Infrastructure', all model tests must execute against isolated schema without cross-case leakage.

tasks.description: Implement isolated ChatService branch tests with mocked model, redis, and connection dependencies.

steps.description: Create test doubles for model queries, redis publish, TCP connection send.
Add login branch tests with valid payload plus wrong-password payload.
Add registration branch tests for success plus duplicate account payloads.
Add add-friend branch tests for success plus nonexistent target payloads.
Add group-chat branch tests for joined member plus non-member payloads.
Assert ACK errno plus errmsg outputs for each failure branch.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: ChatService unit tests must cover login, registration, add-friend, and group-chat key branches. Failure branches must assert errno and errmsg outputs for each invalid condition. Tests must verify request_id echo behavior in ACK payloads where protocol requires it.

unit: Given mocked UserModel login success response for id=101, login handler must emit ACK errno=0 with matching user id in payload.
Given mocked password mismatch response, login handler must emit ACK errno!=0 with non-empty errmsg.
Given mocked duplicate registration response, registration handler must emit ACK errno for duplicate account case.
Given mocked GroupModel membership=false, group-chat handler must reject send with expected error code.
Given fixed request_id='r-123', each handler ACK must preserve request_id='r-123' in output JSON.
integration: When connected to real layer 'Implement Model Layer Unit Tests', ChatService integration cases must consume actual model outputs for login plus add-friend branches.
When connected to real layer 'Establish Deterministic Cpp Test Infrastructure', ChatService integration cases must execute with isolated database state per test run.

tasks.description: Create reusable pytest fixtures for socket protocol calls, request id generation, timeout control, and data cleanup.

steps.description: Create pytest fixture that opens chat server socket clients.
Create helper that sends JSON payload with unique request_id.
Create helper that receives ACK within configurable timeout.
Create cleanup fixture that removes test users after module run.
Package helpers for reuse across registration login friend group tests.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Pytest harness must provide reusable client fixtures with deterministic request_id generation. ACK helper must fail fast on timeout with explicit assertion context. Cleanup fixture must remove generated test data so repeated suite runs can start from clean state.

unit: Given mocked socket recv returning fragmented JSON chunks, ACK parser helper must reconstruct valid message object with expected request_id.
Given no recv data before timeout limit, ACK helper must raise timeout assertion with elapsed milliseconds in message.
Given seed prefix 'itest', request_id helper must produce unique ids across 100 sequential calls.
integration: When connected to real layer 'Implement ChatService Logic Unit Tests' runtime binary, harness fixture must complete a register-login-logout handshake with ACK errno=0 path.
When connected to real layer 'Establish Deterministic Cpp Test Infrastructure' database setup, cleanup fixture must leave zero rows for generated test usernames.

tasks.task: Implement End-to-End Flow Tests And Update Issue Checklist
tasks.description: Implement pytest flow tests for registration, login, friend addition, and group chat, then update Issue 9 and Issue 10 completion states.

steps.description: Add registration flow test with unique account generation.
Add login flow test with valid credential assertion.
Add add-friend flow test with two prepared users.
Add group-chat flow test with creator plus joined members.
Add negative tests for duplicate friend, missing group, unauthorized send.
Update Issue 9 checklist boxes to checked state.
Update Issue 10 checklist boxes to checked state.
Update Issue 9 status text to 已完成.
Update Issue 10 status text to 已完成.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Registration flow test must create a new account and receive success ACK. Login flow test must receive success ACK with valid user id. Add-friend flow test must create relation visible to friend query results. Group-chat flow test must deliver message to joined members within timeout budget. GITHUB_ISSUES_TODO.md must mark Issue 9 and Issue 10 acceptance boxes as checked with status 已完成.

unit: Given mocked ACK payload for registration success, response validator must classify case as pass with expected errno=0.
Given mocked friend-list payload missing target id, friend assertion helper must fail with explicit missing id message.
Given mocked group message event with request_id mismatch, event matcher must reject event plus report expected request_id.
integration: When connected to real layer 'Build Python Socket Test Harness', registration plus login flows must pass against running chat server instance.
When connected to real layer 'Implement ChatService Logic Unit Tests' validated runtime, add-friend flow must return success ACK plus updated friend query result.
When connected to real layer 'Build Python Socket Test Harness' with three clients, group-chat flow must deliver one sent message to each joined member client.
e2e-manual: Human verifies one real multi-client session in terminal where A creates group, B joins group, A sends message, B observes arrival within expected delay.
Human reviews GITHUB_ISSUES_TODO.md to confirm Issue 9 and Issue 10 show 已完成 with all acceptance checkboxes checked.
